summary: DoRaa Sangam House is a luxury-themed React single-page e-commerce storefront backed by an Internet Computer (Motoko) canister. The storefront supports product browsing (collections + category overlays), product detail deep-links, wishlist and cart persistence, Razorpay (test mode) checkout that creates orders on the canister, and a user dashboard for profile + order history. The project also includes two admin experiences: (1) an Internet Identity–gated admin panel under /admin/* for managing the product catalog (CRUD + bulk CSV/ZIP import) and (2) a hidden OTP-based admin flow at /admin-login that sets a cookie session flag and protects an exact /admin route via a backend session validation call.

existing_features.title: Centralized brand identity constants
existing_features.description: Exports the brand name and consistent asset paths (logo mark, favicon, assistant avatar) for use across the application.

existing_features.title: Luxury dark theme UI system with Tailwind + shadcn/ui
existing_features.description: Implements a premium dark UI design using Tailwind with OKLCH CSS variables and shadcn/ui components, plus reusable interaction styles (glows, shimmer skeletons, premium cards/buttons) and reduced-motion overrides.

existing_features.title: Custom SPA routing and navigation (History API)
existing_features.description: Provides lightweight client-side navigation without React Router by tracking pathname/search via the History API and broadcasting route updates to all hook instances.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Manages AuthClient initialization, login/logout, restored sessions, and status/error state, with UI helpers that suppress benign “already authenticated” errors.

existing_features.title: Identity-bound canister actor creation with RBAC initialization
existing_features.description: Creates anonymous or identity-bound canister actors and initializes backend access control using a secret token taken from the URL hash; invalidates and refetches dependent React Query caches when the actor changes.

existing_features.title: Motoko RBAC authorization and role management
existing_features.description: Implements roles (admin/user/guest), one-time initialization, role queries, and admin-only role assignment used to protect backend APIs.

existing_features.title: Canister-backed user profile storage with frontend fallback hook
existing_features.description: Stores user profiles in the canister keyed by Principal with access control; the frontend hook loads/saves via canister when possible and falls back to localStorage for resilience.

existing_features.title: Storefront simulated OTP login with WebOTP assist and lockout
existing_features.description: Implements sign-in/sign-up flows with international phone input, simulated OTP send/verify, optional WebOTP auto-read attempt, 2-minute countdown expiry, 3-attempt lockout with timer modal, and localStorage session persistence.

existing_features.title: Protected route and auth-gated actions with return paths
existing_features.description: Redirects unauthenticated users to /login?tab=signin while storing a return path and showing deduplicated flash messages for protected routes and gated actions (wishlist/cart/checkout).

existing_features.title: Inactivity-based auto-logout
existing_features.description: Automatically logs users out after 30 minutes of inactivity, clearing session state and redirecting to login with an informational flash message.

existing_features.title: Storefront product querying with mapping layer
existing_features.description: Fetches products from the canister via publicListProducts and maps backend Product records into a storefront-friendly shape (variants→colors/sizes, images normalization, Nat/bigint conversions) with caching and toast-based error handling.

existing_features.title: Collections page with infinite scroll and empty states
existing_features.description: Renders a responsive product grid with skeleton loading, premium empty state messaging, and IntersectionObserver-powered infinite scroll paging.

existing_features.title: Premium product card UI with quick details overlay
existing_features.description: Displays luxury product cards with image zoom-on-hover, deterministic discount formatting utilities, badges, rating display, wishlist/cart actions with premium micro-interactions, and a desktop hover overlay showing color swatches/fabric/size-chart link/blouse pairing.

existing_features.title: Quick view product sheet
existing_features.description: Provides a right-side quick view panel with product gallery thumbnails, pricing/badges, and add-to-cart, with auth gating for interactions.

existing_features.title: Deep-linked product detail route (/product/:id)
existing_features.description: Supports direct navigation to product detail URLs and renders a full-screen product detail view with zoomable image gallery, wishlist/cart actions, and modal-style close behavior.

existing_features.title: Dynamic SEO metadata management
existing_features.description: Dynamically sets and restores document title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and canonical link tags for product and category contexts.

existing_features.title: Wishlist persistence in localStorage
existing_features.description: Allows users to add/remove/toggle favorite product IDs and persists the list across sessions using localStorage.

existing_features.title: Cart state management with local persistence
existing_features.description: Manages cart items in localStorage with add/update/remove/clear actions, derived cart item count, and a computed cart total (from locally stored product data).

existing_features.title: Cart UI as a right-side sheet with quantity controls
existing_features.description: Provides a cart side-sheet showing line items with quantity adjustments, removal, and subtotal/total display, plus a checkout CTA that is auth-gated.

existing_features.title: Razorpay (test mode) checkout and canister order creation
existing_features.description: Collects contact/shipping info, initiates Razorpay Checkout in test mode, creates an order in the canister upon payment success, and clears the local cart.

existing_features.title: Checkout sheet flow with success confirmation
existing_features.description: Wraps checkout inside a sheet and transitions to a success view displaying the order ID and a continue-shopping action.

existing_features.title: Order history retrieval and filtering support
existing_features.description: Fetches user orders from the canister and supports year/month filtering via a dedicated canister method and React Query hook, with fallback to all orders when unfiltered.

existing_features.title: User dashboard UI (profile, orders, addresses)
existing_features.description: Provides a protected user dashboard with profile editing (backend sync), order history list with details dialog and date filtering controls, and local address management UI.

existing_features.title: Premium interaction utilities and toasts
existing_features.description: Standardizes luxury feedback: gold ripple effects, fly-to-cart animation, premium-styled toasts (success/error/info/duplicate), and a minimal gold-bordered error toast helper.

existing_features.title: Cinematic hero slider and motion-safe text animations
existing_features.description: Full-screen hero carousel with autoplay, pause-on-interaction, swipe/drag gestures, dot/arrow navigation, gold wipe transitions, and reduced-motion friendly text animations.

existing_features.title: Cinematic ocean background animation
existing_features.description: Renders a fixed, full-viewport canvas ocean scene with parallax influences, cached noise/tables for stability, foam particles, sand texture, and a reduced-motion static fallback.

existing_features.title: Rule-based RaaHi assistant chat widget
existing_features.description: Floating assistant widget with session-based auto-greeting, typing simulation, message history, and keyword-based canned responses (no external LLM).

existing_features.title: Static SEO discovery assets
existing_features.description: Provides robots.txt and sitemap.xml for indexing guidance (allowing public storefront/product routes while disallowing admin/login/dashboard).

existing_features.title: PWA support with offline app-shell caching
existing_features.description: Ships a PWA manifest and a service worker that caches core static assets for offline app-shell support with runtime cache + network fallback for same-origin resources.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity admin panel (layout, login, and route gating)
existing_features.description: Provides an Internet Identity–gated admin panel under /admin/* with a login page, principal-based access checks, header/sidebar layout, and internal admin routing for dashboard/products pages.

existing_features.title: Canister-backed admin product management (CRUD)
existing_features.description: Implements admin catalog management backed by canister APIs: list products, create/edit with validation (fabric presets/custom, colors, sizes, blouse pairing, 5–10 images), and delete with confirmation dialogs and toast feedback.

existing_features.title: Admin bulk product upload (CSV/ZIP)
existing_features.description: Supports selecting/validating CSV or ZIP, extracting/reading CSV, parsing rows into product form data, bulk importing to the canister, and showing progress with exact “X products added” success messaging (plus a simulated schedule action).

existing_features.title: Admin save feedback and return highlight
existing_features.description: Adds save toasts and temporary highlight animations to product cards when returning to the admin products list after create/edit operations, with reduced-motion support.

existing_features.title: Hidden admin OTP login flow and OTP-protected /admin route
existing_features.description: Implements an unlinked OTP-based admin login page that calls canister requestAdminOtp/verifyAdminOtp, stores an admin session flag in a cookie on success, and protects the exact /admin route by validating the session via a backend call and rendering either “Admin Dashboard – Protected” or “Access denied”.

existing_features.title: Backend product catalog APIs (public + admin)
existing_features.description: Stores products in a canister map, provides public listing for the storefront, and admin-only list/create/update/delete/bulk-import APIs guarded by RBAC checks.

existing_features.title: Backend orders APIs
existing_features.description: Allows authenticated users to create paid orders (orderId, paymentId, shipping address) and retrieve their order history from the canister.

existing_features.title: Backend admin OTP allowlist + session validation endpoints
existing_features.description: Implements a mock admin OTP flow in the canister using a phone allowlist and fixed OTP validation ("123456"), recording a session (clientIp + userAgent + lastActive) and exposing a validateAdminSession check with a 4-hour timeout.

existing_features.title: HTTP outcall helper module (backend)
existing_features.description: Includes a reusable Motoko module for IC HTTP GET/POST outcalls with a response transform that strips headers and a fixed cycles budget per request.

existing_features.title: Build/deploy template scaffold (React + IC canisters)
existing_features.description: Adds a reusable build-template scaffold including Dockerfile, deployment scripts/config (icp.yaml/canister.yaml), pnpm workspace setup, and frontend tooling/scripts (lint rules, image prune/resize) to standardize build and deployment of the React + Internet Computer canister app.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a custom-routed SPA (no React Router), using History API state + a custom navigation event (useSpaLocation) and route switching in App.tsx.
TanStack React Query is used for actor lifecycle, canister queries/mutations (products, orders, admin session validation), and cache invalidation/refetch on actor changes.
Authentication is hybrid: user-facing login is simulated OTP + optional Internet Identity passkey login, while canister authorization relies on Internet Identity principals and backend RBAC.
Backend authorization is implemented via AccessControl + MixinAuthorization, with an initialization step that can grant the first caller admin based on a secret token.
Product data is mapped across layers (backend Product ↔ admin forms ↔ storefront StorefrontProduct), including variant-derived colors/sizes and bigint/Nat conversions.
Commerce/cart is managed in a React context with localStorage persistence, with UI delivered via shadcn/ui Sheets and premium interaction utilities.
Checkout integrates the external Razorpay Checkout script (loaded once), then writes orders to the canister and clears the local cart on success.
SEO/PWA are built-in: dynamic metadata hook for title/OG/Twitter/canonical tags, robots.txt + sitemap.xml, and a service worker caching an offline app shell.
Motion/UX is emphasized: prefers-reduced-motion is respected across background canvases, hero slider animations, hover interactions, and save feedback animations.
Admin functionality is modularized under /admin/* with an AdminGate, AdminLayout shell, and an AdminProductsProvider managing canister-backed catalog operations.
known_issues: Internet Identity admin gating is effectively misconfigured: ADMIN_PRINCIPAL is hardcoded to the anonymous principal ("2vxsx-fae"), so real principals will be denied admin access.
Backend order timestamps are hard-coded (Order.createOrderRecord sets a constant timestamp), making displayed order dates incorrect.
getUserOrdersByYearMonth filters using a YYYYMMDD-style range (year*10000+month*100+day) against timestamps, which is incompatible with epoch-millisecond timestamps even if timestamps were correct.
Cart total calculation relies on localStorage key "doraa-admin-products" rather than the canister-fetched product list, so totals/checkout amounts can be wrong or zero.
Storefront product mapping (backendToStorefrontProduct/adminToStorefrontProduct) assigns random rating/reviewCount values per fetch, creating non-deterministic UI metrics.
AdminProductsProvider.createProduct refreshes then searches for the new product in a potentially stale products state closure, which can throw "Product created but not found in list".

OTP-admin session implementation is inconsistent: the cookie token is not passed to the backend (validateAdminSession ignores token), and validateAdminSession additionally requires admin role, making the OTP-only path likely to deny/ trap in practice.

verifyAdminOtp attempts to assign admin role via AccessControl.assignRole, which itself requires the caller to already be admin; this likely prevents OTP-based self-promotion without prior RBAC initialization.
ZIP→CSV extraction is a simplified ZIP parser that assumes uncompressed entries; many real ZIP archives will fail without a proper ZIP library.
There are duplicate/legacy theme CSS files (frontend/index.css vs frontend/src/index.css), increasing confusion about which theme/tokens are active.
